summary: node1 now has a persistent 2.50 GiB XFS logical volume mounted at /srv/data. It was grown online from 1.00 GiB without unmounting, retained its payload and checksum, and recovered successfully after reboot.
actions_performed: Created PV /dev/loop0, VG vg_data, and LV lv_data.
Formatted and mounted the LV at /srv/data.
Created and checksummed a verification payload.
Extended the mounted LV and filesystem online from 1.00 GiB to 2.50 GiB.
Configured persistent backing-device activation and mounting.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified full recovery.

evidence.summary: Shows vg_data/lv_data active at 1.00 GiB, mounted as XFS at /srv/data with the verification payload.

evidence.requirement: Grow to at least 2 GB while mounted with contents intact
evidence.summary: The online resize grew the active LV from 1.00 GiB to 2.50 GiB. /srv/data remained mounted and payload checksum da547090377388ae34ca1a2919fb7256652923480e3caab4356a0b5facb3c01c was unchanged.
The boot setup service is enabled and active; fstab verification completed without errors or warnings.

Healthy pre-restart boot ID was 646e5f74-dc0e-45e7-9746-226c4351af28; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to ad4704f6-4cb0-4fb6-a809-955e6b54f937. The system returned to running state with the 2.50 GiB LV active, /srv/data mounted, and the original payload checksum intact.
